2026-09-14 · Plenary

People's Assembly Hearing with the Minister of Education

The Minister of Education, Mohammad Abdulrahman Tarkou, appears before the People's Assembly at the third sitting of its first extraordinary session. Members ask about school capacity, dismissed and contract teachers, school restoration, curricula, exams and private education, and the minister presents the ministry's plans and answers their questions.
